title: Classification Hydrocyclone

introduction.definition: Hydrocyclones classify slurries by particle size using centrifugal force. Slurry fed tangentially spins in the cyclone; coarse particles move to the wall and leave at the apex, while fines and most of the liquid leave through the central vortex finder.

working_principle.characteristic_curve: Partition curve; d50 ≈ f(D^1.5…, ΔP^−0.25…) per Plitt/maker correlations.

pressure.title: Centrifugal classification
pressure.description: Feed enters tangentially under pressure (typically ~ 0.5–2 bar), forming an outer downward vortex and an inner upward vortex. Coarse/dense particles are thrown to the wall and leave at the apex; fines and most of the liquid leave through the vortex finder. The d50 cut size falls with smaller diameter and higher pressure; apex size controls the underflow density (avoid "roping").

video_tutorials.title: Classification Hydrocyclone — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Classification Hydrocyclone.
Hydrocyclones classify slurries by particle size using centrifugal force.
Slurry fed tangentially spins in the cyclone; coarse particles move to the wall and leave at the apex, while fines and most of the liquid leave through the central vortex finder.
Typical applications include hydrate classification; mill circuit classification; sand separation.
The cutaway reveals the internal construction.
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

script.narration: How the Classification Hydrocyclone works.
Feed enters the distributor.
Tangential entry creates a vortex.
Coarse particles spiral down to the apex.
Fines go up the vortex finder to the overflow launder.
The flow overlay traces the liquid from suction to discharge.
Feed enters tangentially under pressure (typically ~ 0.5–2 bar), forming an outer downward vortex and an inner upward vortex.

video_tutorials.title: Classification Hydrocyclone — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Classification Hydrocyclone.
Watch underflow shape (spray vs rope).
Measure apex wear.
Replace liners.
Watch for roping: thick rope underflow, coarse overflow. Common cause: overloaded apex.
Watch for apex wear: dilute underflow. Common cause: abrasion.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
